senses.gloss: मौल (I) a. (f. ला or ली) 1. Original, radical; 2. ancient, old; 3. nobly born; 4. brought up in the service of a king for generations, hereditary, R.xix.57.
मौल (II) m. A hereditary minister, R.xii.12, xiv.10.
मौल (I) a. (f. ला or ली) 1. Original, radical; 2. ancient, old; 3. nobly born; 4. brought up in the service of a king for generations, hereditary, R.xix.57.
मौल (I) a. (f. ला or ली) 1. Original, radical; 2. ancient, old; 3. nobly born; 4. brought up in the service of a king for generations, hereditary, R.xix.57.
मौलि (I) m. 1. The head, विलिप्यते मौलिभिरंबरौकसाम् K.S.v.79, R.xiii.59; 2. the Aśoka tree.
मौलि (II) m.f. 1. Hair on the crown of the head, K.S.ii.26; 2. hair of the head braided and ornamented; 3. a crown, a diadem.
मौलि-मणि m. a crest jewel, a head jewel.
मौलि-रत्न n. a crest jewel, a head jewel.
